name: Salinas [Santa Elena]

routes.outcome: Official GAD Municipal del Cantón Salinas site loaded. It identifies the municipality and links official institutional material; no public parcel map/API link was exposed in the page shell.
Official municipal ordinance index exposes the 2026-2027 cadastral ordinance, establishing the local cadastral competency and current municipal context; it is not a parcel geometry service.
Official municipal cadastral ordinance documents Unidad de Catastro y Avalúos, cadastral coding and parcel-fiche fields. Owner, contact, title and tax fields were not requested or retained.
Official Sistema de Registro de la Propiedad login page loaded anonymously. Login wall encountered; no credentials, private tokens or unsafe registry fields were requested.
Official national IEDG viewer host returned HTTP 403. No CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or alternate protected route was attempted.

Official IGM viewer shell loaded anonymously. Visible/configured content was thematic mapping (including physical-construction suitability and other national layers), not a verified Salinas cadastral parcel layer; no parcel response was retained.
National registry agency prose was found, but it does not evidence a Salinas local parcel viewer/API or anonymous geometry route; treated as general national agency context only.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Municipal site HTML, official cadastral ordinance, official Registro de la Propiedad login shell, IEDG viewer link and IGM AFC viewer shell were inspected.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: Municipal ordinance describes a local cadastral code composed from administrative, zone, sector, manzana/poligono, predio and property-horizontal/division components, but no parcel feature record was obtained to validate a composite key.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if exposed

qualification.reason: A local cadastral custodian is evidenced, but no anonymous parcel layer, schema, native identity, CRS or bounded geometry response was obtained.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
No exact-point parcel query succeeded; this is not evidence of citywide absence.
No full parcel polygons are retained because no safe native-identity geometry response was obtained.

The GAD Municipal del Cantón Salinas and Unidad de Catastro y Avalúos are treated as the local cadastral custodian; IEDG, IGM and Registrospublicos are national/general agency routes and are not treated as local parcel custodians.
The Registro de la Propiedad login wall and IEDG HTTP 403 were not bypassed.
The packet is complete as a research record, not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The local municipal cadastral mandate and coding model are documented, but the current public parcel viewer/API, native parcel identity, field schema, CRS, anonymous query behavior and citywide geometry coverage remain unresolved.
